summary.intent: Act on a peer Claude session's request to simplify a PR by deleting code that config can no longer reach (the E339 binding guard, the unreachable NuGet variant and its match arms), then push and later merge main and resolve the E330 row in docs/errors.md after #590 merges.
summary.outcome: Removed the E339 guard, NuGet variant, match arms, related tests, Retargeted helper, is_implemented methods, RegistryKey::NUGET, and README/docs references across callisto-model and callisto-graph; lint and tests passed except a known sandbox npm-cache failure. Ran cargo fmt and created a signed commit, but the push, post-#590 merge of main, and E330 resolution are not shown as completed.

repo: AGENTS.md says to delete a check once a type covers it, and pre-1.0 dead error codes can be removed outright.
Removing the NuGet variant cascaded into is_implemented on PublishTarget and Ecosystem, RegistryKey::NUGET, README text, and the E199/E339 rows in docs/errors.md.
docs/errors.md holds error-code rows (E199, E330, E339) that must be kept in sync with error.rs.
Commits are signed and must be created outside the sandbox.
The repo uses `just lint`; `cargo fmt` for the workspace matters, as formatting blank lines caused a recommit.
workflow: Map all references with grep before deleting, and check the cascade, such as helpers used only by the removed test (Retargeted), before removing code.
Editing a file bottom-up keeps line numbers valid across multiple edits in one pass.
The peer asked to stop and report if the removal reached beyond the PR's files, so a scope check came first.
Run only the crate tests that can run in the sandbox, plus lint; CI covers the rest.
